d:
Eeran ne ameriki rashtrapti donald tranp ki ek aur hamle ki chetavni ka javab diya hai. rashtrapti donald tranp ne shukravar ko amerika ke florida men kaha tha ki amerika eeran ke khilaf chhota 'epik fyuri' chala sakta hai. amerika ne eeran ke khilaf apne pichhle militri opreshan ko 'epik fyuri' nam diya tha. lekin ab eeran ne bhi tranp ki is chetavni ka sakhti se javab diya hai. itna hi nahin eeran ne apni aarthik sthiti ke bare men bhi ek byora samne rakha hai.
